methods.name: RNA sequencing
methods.protocol_description: RNAseq was performed on organoids treated with or without RA. Reads were aligned to the mouse genome (Ensembl release 94) using STAR v2.6.0c and summarized per gene with featureCounts. Differential expression analysis was performed using DESeq2 v1.18.1, focusing on 18 and 30 h post-day 2 time points. Genes with log2 fold change < -1 or > 1 and FDR 0.01 in both time points were considered significantly regulated.
